description: Permissions for the main RL Studio window. `decorations: false` means the OS draws no title bar, so every affordance a real one provides is re-implemented in HTML and has to call back through these window permissions: without them the window cannot be dragged, minimized, maximized or closed. `allow-show` exists because the window is created hidden and revealed by the frontend once it has painted, which avoids a white flash on launch. The remaining two cover the settings store and opening documentation links in the user's own browser.
